Śāntoditāvyapadeśyadharmānupātī dharmī /III.14/
Śānta-udita-avyapadeśya-dharma-anupātī dharmī /III.14/

« La substance [porteuse de qualités] est ce qui se reconduit auprès des propriétés
passées, présentes et à venir. »

Tatra-- Śānta-udita-avyapadeśya-dharma-anupātī dharmī / Yogyatā-avacchinnā
dharmiṇaḥ śaktir eva dharmaḥ / Sa ca phala-prasava-bheda-anumita-sad-bhāva
1468 ekasya–
anyo'nyaś ca paridṛṣṭaḥ / Tatra vartamānaḥ sva-vyāpāram anubhavan dharmī dharma-
antarebhyaḥ
1469 śāntebhyaś ca–avyapadeśyebhyaś ca bhidyate / Yadā tu sāmānyena
samanvāgato bhavati tadā dharmi-svarūpa-mātratvāt ko'sau kena bhidyeta ? Tatra trayaḥ
khalu dharmiṇo
1470 dharmāḥ śāntā uditā avyapadeśyā ca–iti / Tatra śāntā ye kṛtvā vyāpārān
uparatāḥ ; savyāpārā uditāḥ ; te ca–anāgatasya lak�
